title: NASA SpaceX Crew-13 Mission Launch
desc: Follow Bhaskar English for latest updates on NASA SpaceX Crew-13 mission from Florida. Four astronauts are getting ready to leave Earth for the International Space Station (ISS) as NASA and SpaceX prepare for the next crew rotation mission. Crew-13 is currently targeted to launch on October 1, 2026, at 11:10 a.m. EDT (8:40 p.m. IST) from Florida.
